items.stem: Why is knitting an R Markdown document more reproducible than saving a workspace image?

options.text: It re-runs the code from the source each time, so results match the code
options.rationale: Correct: knitting executes the analysis fresh, keeping outputs consistent with the code.

options.text: It compresses the data more efficiently
options.rationale: Reproducibility is about re-executing code, not compression.

options.text: It prevents anyone from editing the code
options.rationale: The source remains editable; that is not the point.

options.text: It stores results without the code
options.rationale: A workspace image stores results without code, which is the less reproducible option.

items.explanation: Correct: knitting re-executes the source so outputs always reflect the current code.
